_help: Written daily by automation/promo-pipeline.gs from Awin promo emails (see automation/README.md). You can also edit it by hand: add a brand under brands and its codes under offers. Offers without 'expires' stay listed for 30 days from 'listed'. Set "blocked": true on a brand to hide it. Rakuten brands (network "rakuten") carry their own tracking link in "link" on the brand and on each offer.
